title: Running a command
hints: exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...) builds the command, and the process is killed if ctx ends first. Point cmd.Stdout at a bytes.Buffer to capture the output, then call cmd.Run().
A non-zero exit status comes back from Run as an *exec.ExitError. Use errors.As to get it and its ExitCode(). That's a normal result here, not an error.
Check ctx.Err() first: if the context ended, return it. Any other error from Run (the program doesn't exist, for example) is a real error.
